scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,QUEUE,SCHEDULE,CLIENT,SCRAPER "cd api && php artisan serve" "cd api && php artisan queue:work" "cd api && php artisan schedule:work" "cd client && bun run dev" "cd scraper && .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -u app.py"
